name: branding-interlocking-s-symbol-with-sans-wordmark
title: Violet interlocking S-shaped symbol from rounded pipes beside a bold sans wordmark
whatItIs: A white slide with a violet symbol made of two rounded L-shaped pipes forming an S with cross-shaped negative space, next to a black bold grotesque wordmark 'Sovrix'.
whatItMeans: Clean and technical; rounded joins make it friendly and the negative cross hints at connection.
techniques: Build an initial from rounded pipe segments.
Leave negative space forming a plus or cross.
Pair a coloured symbol with a black wordmark.
Match the wordmark's roundness to the symbol.

vocabulary.definition: Forms built from constant-width rounded segments.
A plus shape formed by gaps.
Symbol and name side by side.
A curved corner where segments meet.
